beats.say: Domestic cats purr at a steady frequency of 20 to 30 vibrations per second.
This soft buzzing sound rests around a fundamental frequency of 25 Hz.
Cats have been observed to purr for most of their lifespan, starting from when they were young and suckling from their mother.
Even the snow leopard, a felid species with an incompletely ossified hyoid, has this ability.
That was Wild World, subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
Knowing this unique frequency means you can always remember that domestic cats purr at a steady frequency of 20 to 30 vibrations per second.

facts: Domestic cats purr at a frequency of 20 to 30 vibrations per second.
Purring is a soft buzzing sound with a fundamental frequency of around 25 Hz.
The snow leopard is a felid species with an incompletely ossified hyoid that purrs.
Cats have been observed to purr for most of their lifespan, starting from when they were young and suckling from their mother.
